query: I've decided to go on a last-minute hiking trip, so I need to get some gear delivered very quickly. First, I'm looking for a general women's item that I can get soon, so it needs a transport time of less than 5 days and must have less than 5 two-star reviews. For the hike itself, I'm searching for a specific 'Active Logo Training Top' that's popular and well-regarded, so it must have a total sales volume over 20,000 and an average rating score greater than 4.5, with transport time under 2 days. To go with that, I need some orange 'Hiking Bottoms' for women with more than 60 four-star reviews, also arriving in less than 2 days. Finally, I’m looking for an olive green item from Patagonia with a total sales volume over 4500 and an average rating above 4.5, which also needs a transport time of less than 2 days.
